intro: Government and critical infrastructure sectors bore the brunt of a concentrated threat wave between April and July 2026, as tracked across 17 articles under the CISA tag. Threat actors GRU, Interlock, and LummaC2 were observed exploiting vulnerabilities including CVE-2024-57726, CVE-2026-21643, CVE-2026-34197, CVE-2024-1708, and CVE-2024-20662. The 14 high-severity and 3 critical-severity incidents primarily affected the United States, global operations, North America, and Europe, with technology, defense, and energy sectors also frequently targeted.
